most_similar_reason: Candidate 7 shares the target's core creation sequence in unusually close detail: a solitary, white-formed creator amid primordial darkness and water who brings forth sun, moon and stars, produces humankind (including a white man set to rule), teaches them the arts such as fire-making, and then withdraws from the world.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 2 is a revenge-and-escape tale about a crippled smith who murders a king's sons and seduces his daughter, containing no creation, no civilizing teaching, no flood, and no departing culture-hero figure at all.
